First off, I apologize for posting this here. I know it is definitely the wrong place to post this but it was the only one I thought of that had like minded people in it.

The idea is to have a subverse that is used as a directory for online gaming. VLFG[Voat looking for group] The directory would list genres of games that can be played with others.

e.g. FPS RPG MMO SANDBOX STORY CO-OP

The genre subverse would then list off popular multiplayer games within that genre. Once in the game subverse, it would then list servers and be used as a bulletin board for people looking to play with each other. The servers wouldn't have to be dedicated voat/reddit servers, just somewhere that is known or that voaters can get together and play.

The subverses that act as a directory for games should be locked imo, and moderated by a small group of people. To minimize spam and overlapping management.

The game lfg subverses wouldnt be the dedicated subverse for that game. Just a place where people can find a group for that game,the CSGO subverse isnt CSGO_LFG. Yet they should be intertwined, meaning there would be a link to the game subverse in the lfg-verse, and vice versa.

I figured since reddit was missing a lfg community, aside from dayz, and that voat is new and has a smaller populous. We could form an awesome lfg directory that a person could navigate through to find other people to play with. Due to the smaller population, this could be done somewhat fast and easy, without having to worry about mod politics.

Problems/Obstacles

  • Organization
  • Management[Mods] Finding trustworthy and competent people who have time to Mod.
  • Trolls
  • Implenting it
  • Organizing x game into y genre
  • Time. This would probably take a couple of days to do, so volunteers willing to help.

If done correctly, I believe that this could not only streamline someone's search to play with others, but bring our community closer as well.

I appreciate your time and please give me your thoughts.

I know that having advertisers can cause big problems for any web site. For example, if you ran a giant food blog and became sponsored by Coke, then Coke might want you to sign a contract saying that you can only drink Coke. If one day you drank Pepsi and it showed in a photo, Coke could try to sue at the worst, or simply pull their funding. Even if you wanted to drink a Pepsi you wouldn't be able to because of your contract.

However, advertising does not have to work in that way if Voat is not partnered by contract with larger companies like Reddit is. Voat could still earn some money to help with servers by offering basic advertising (through a simple advertising page, and not partnership contracts). This extra money could help support the site and also offer companies a way to advertise through Voat. I don't run a large company like other advertisers do, but I like the user base here at Voat and I would really love if I could somehow put a small unobtrusive ad on Voat to help support them as well. Of course, if users don't want ads at all on the site, then I'd understand it's good to not do this. Or maybe turning off ads could be a simple checkbox in the user settings, and advertisers are only charged for the ads people look at? Just throwing out some ideas and seeing if any stick.
